assets.name: SafetyBattery
assets.prompt: Use this reference sheet as the PRIMARY art direction: these are established sprites from the same RimWorld mod. Match their actual 2D illustration treatment: thin clear black contours, mid-gray broad metal plates, SMALL narrow light edge facets, mostly flat matte fills with faint painted variation. Match LaserCapacitor and MissileMagazine detail density, NOT a highly beveled 3D render. A few broad functional pieces with restrained depth. No oversized bolts, decorative greebles, nested borders, broad shiny chamfers, soft rendered lighting or smooth gradients. Strict orthographic top view, original design, transparent RGBA background with absolutely no shadow or haze outside silhouette. No text, labels, ground. Do not copy the sheet or create a sheet; output ONE centered complete sprite, even small transparent margins. Subject: a 3x2 standalone reserve battery bank on a LANDSCAPE 3:2 canvas. Three broad sealed muted warm-gray battery cells side by side, each with just ONE dark transverse seam and simple flat gray end caps. A modest gray rectangular mounting frame with small clipped corners and two thin retaining bars between cells. On south edge one small red manual disconnect and one tiny blue indicator. NO bolts or protruding terminal blocks, NO multiple concentric cell frames. Keep the useful cell structure, but reduce surface segmentation: about12 broad functional shapes total. It must belong beside the reference cargo container and capacitor, with the same quiet outlined gray industrial design.
assets.framingPrompt: Refine ONLY the canvas fit of this approved-style battery sprite. Preserve its exact illustrated design, palette, thin black outlines, restrained narrow edge highlights, three battery cells, seams and red switch. No added detail. The current transparent margins are much too large. Output landscape3:2 transparent canvas; enlarge the battery so its outer silhouette occupies about92% of canvas WIDTH and85-90% of HEIGHT (roughly4% horizontal padding,6% vertical padding). Broaden the three cells slightly to fit a 3x2 footprint if needed. Do not crop any solid part, and do not add a base, background, halo, shadow or perspective. Keep the same calm flat RimWorld mod style. This is a framing correction, not a redesign.
